name: pg_foreign_key_bugs_foreign_keys
area: foreign keys, partition attach and detach
goal:
Foreign keys on partitioned tables can be corrupted or crash during attach and detach when a partition's physical column order differs from its parent's, especially after dropped columns. The resulting trigger may read the wrong attributes, and some DDL paths can also attempt an unsafe lock escalation.

Build a partitioned referenced table and a referencing partition whose logical key columns have different attribute numbers, attach it, and exercise inserts plus detach/finalize operations. A violating row must be rejected using the logical key columns, valid rows must remain valid, and attach/detach must neither crash nor leave broken constraints. Equivalent concurrent DDL must not introduce a lock-upgrade deadlock; ordinary same-layout foreign keys must be unchanged.
